library: Vidyalaya boasts of a well equipped library with approximately 15,000 books including Fiction, Non-Fiction and Reference Books catering to the needs of different age groups of students. Weeklies, Journals and Dailies keep the students and staff up-to-date with the events happening in and around.
laboratories: Scientifically advanced laboratories for Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science and Mathematics.
audio-visual-room: Audio Visual Room is well equipped with the latest audio visual aids like LCD projector, Over Head Projector, Slide Projector, TV, Computers etc
digital-classrooms: Smart Class programme transforms our present day classrooms into technology enabled classrooms. It has revolutionized the way a teacher teaches in the classroom making the learning process both cognitive and constructive. It is an innovative technology that helps the students to benefit from animations and audio visual inputs based on the topics learnt. The digitalized classes offer a practical approach which focuses on the child's interest and helps them to be cognizant of the wide diversity of learning styles. This technology offers suitable aid for students from KG to Plus Two. We hope to provide our children the best solution to develop both in the cognitive and intellectual level.
playground: The campus has three playgrounds - Football Court, Basketball Court, 800 mt. Track etc.
sick-bay: We believe that "a healthy mind rests in a healthy body" and "Cleanliness is next to Godliness".
To provide a comfortable ambience when the body and mind is in a state of unrest; the Vidyalaya ensures the "Sick Bay" facility.
apan-mithra: Apan Mithra is the accident management cell that takes charge during short intervals / lunch interval. The responsible members of this cell render help and first aid to the causalities. They are always on their toes.
transport: Five school buses running on five different routes. Other than the regular school trips, conveyance facility is provided for students attending entrance coaching classes.
